source_observation.producer_model_call_id_contract: model_call_id is caller-supplied and copied into HCU_INFERENCE_RECEIPT/v3
source_observation.v1_binder_lane_contract: training trace role only has to occur somewhere in route-level inference_receipt.model_lanes
source_observation.causal_gap: HCU_INFERENCE_RECEIPT/v3 does not identify the output-producing GRID10 cell/lane, so a multi-lane route-level receipt can be post-hoc associated with more than one trace cell.

pr1400.mechanism: derive a deterministic model_call_id from grid_plan_sha256 + cell_id + role and require receipt equality
pr1400.reason: The receipt producer currently accepts model_call_id as a caller-supplied parameter, so a caller can choose the matching derived label without proving that the output was produced by that GRID10 cell. This is label consistency, not causal output-cell identity.

pr1396.mechanism: require the exact GridPlan, cross-bind plan/route/engine identity, and fail closed for HCU_INFERENCE_RECEIPT/v3 unless there is exactly one model lane and one model cell matching the trace role/cell
pr1396.reason: For v3 evidence, single-lane/single-model-cell is the only currently unambiguous output-to-cell case. Multi-lane must remain UNKNOWN/fail-closed until the canonical inference producer emits explicit output-producing cell/lane identity.

future_v4.mechanism: extend the single canonical inference receipt producer with explicit grid_plan_sha256 + output_cell_id + output_model_lane, derived/validated at execution rather than accepted as post-hoc labels
future_v4.reason: Preserves multi-lane HCU capability without weakening causal provenance.

unusual_experiment.setup: One route-level v3 receipt exposes model_lanes=(critic, planner). Two traces reuse the same route/grid identity but claim different model cells/roles. For each trace, the caller supplies the deterministic PR1400-style model_call_id matching that trace.
unusual_experiment.interpretation: The deterministic model_call_id fence does not discriminate the two causal assignments while model_call_id remains caller-controlled. The stronger GridPlan + single-lane v3 policy does discriminate them by refusing both ambiguous assignments.
unusual_experiment.scope_limit: Synthetic mechanism evidence only; not exact HCU runtime evidence and not a model/J-Space runtime claim.

execution_authority_refresh.credit_boundary: Existing component passes do not establish the fused PR1401 full causal spine or whole EntityOS/HCU runtime acceptance.

fusion_decision.required_next_source_delta: Fuse PR1396 binder+regression semantics into the single PR1401 HCU fusion path, then run one fixed exact-source FREE capsule over the resulting minimum causal closure.
